csv_project_name: DB for ESC Fuel Tank Protection Blast Wall Enclosure
csv_scope_of_work: Fort Pierce Utilities Authority (FPUA) is accepting proposals from qualified, licensed and insured contractors to provide a Turnkey Predesigned Blast Wall Enclosure(s) Installation for Fuel Tank Protection at Energy Services Center (ESC) located at 1701 South 37th Street, Fort Pierce, Florida 34947. FPUA to select qualified contractor to deliver complete, design built, HUD compliant blast wall systems, including: One enclosure for the above ground gasoline/diesel fuel tanks One enclosure for the Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) fueling station tank Full hazard modeling (blast, thermal, dispersion) Full structural and civil design All permitting and regulatory submittals Complete construction, commissioning, and turnover of finished systems
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Underground Tank Design, Construction/Project Management, Mechanical Engineering

relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural and civil design for protective blast wall enclosures.
- Special safety-related structure with hazard modeling may involve nonstandard loading and detailing.
- However, the project is primarily a turnkey contractor-led design-build package rather than a pure engineering design tender.
- It is not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, major cultural building or architecturally demanding building type typically most relevant to sbp.
- Strong utility/industrial protection focus limits strategic fit despite some structural complexity.
